_note: Pre-registered 2026-11-17 before any feature result was computed. Exploratory screen: does external data add predictive power over price-only baselines? Do not edit after results exist.

targets.crash_7d: 1 if the minimum close over the next 7 days is <= -10% vs today's close
targets.vol_7d: realised volatility of daily returns over the next 7 days

lagging: Every feature uses only data published before the target window opens. FRED series are lagged 1 extra business day; weekly series (WALCL, WTREGEN) are lagged to their release day. Rolling z-scores use trailing windows only.

periods.note: Derivative metrics only start 2021-12; their in-sample period is shorter. The OOS period has been seen by the team in other contexts; disclosed.

tests.univariate: Spearman rank IC of each feature vs each target, IS and OOS separately; 7d targets use HAC (Newey-West, 7 lags) t-stats.
tests.incremental: Walk-forward monthly refit: ridge regression (ret targets) and logistic regression (crash_7d) on baseline A, then A plus each external group (B, C, D) and all. Report OOS R^2 and OOS AUC/Brier vs A alone.
tests.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 10% across all feature x target univariate OOS tests. Report every test.
tests.event_study: Feature z-scores in the 7 days before the 8 largest 7-day drawdowns of BTC since 2019 (including 2026-11-09..15) vs all other days.

decision_rule: An external group 'contributes' only if (a) it improves OOS AUC for crash_7d by >= 0.03 or OOS R^2 for a return target by >= 0.5 percentage points over baseline A, and (b) at least one of its features survives BH-FDR OOS with the same sign as in-sample.
